falsification_criteria.description: Exact toy examples violate stated specialization checks or change under accepted local controls.
After n31 fills the Z/2 source slots and conventions, the candidate's nontrivial sector disagrees with the sourced theta formula.
The candidate gives incompatible values for presentations that later decorated Kirby-move gates certify as equivalent.
The same input produces nonidentical exact certificates, uses floating approximations, or fails exact character orthogonality.
A basis or H2-marking change is guessed, omitted, or produces different candidate sectors without an explicit recorded matrix and marking interpretation.
Any exact failed example must be recorded as evidence against the candidate formula, the local convention, or the code path; it must not be silently discarded as noise.

requirements.description: Artifacts that attach sectors to decorations must record the Kirby/H2 basis or explicitly state why no marking is in scope.
Basis changes and handle-slide lineage must be represented by explicit integer matrices or structured blockers, not guessed.
Candidate evidence must distinguish marked distinctions, orbit or multiset distinctions, and unsupported unmarked claims.

n33_requirements.description: Every n33 artifact must include the n32 required fields and one ordinary-surgery gate status field or explanation.
n33 outputs may use only candidate-experimental or schema-test-safe claim levels for this contract.
n33 must identify the exact finite_group_id and character_table_source used for sector metadata, and annotate the character_data_source_status for lambda_i(a).
n33 must refuse decorated theorem, closed invariant, exotic detection, and Reutter escape/no-go claims.
n32 itself supplies no Omega_a coefficient implementation; n33 must keep any later coefficient scaffold visibly experimental.

required_source_proof_slots.description: A page-level source, theorem, proposition, or repo-local proof is needed before the display can be promoted beyond a candidate.
The meaning of lambda_i(a) must be tied to an exact character, tensor automorphism, grading, or other stated categorical action.
Handle slides, handle cancellations, orientation conventions, normalization, signature anomaly, and implicit 3-handles must be covered before any closed-invariant claim.
Trivial A or trivial decoration may reduce only to the current ordinary omega/local n22 behavior inside the n24 blocked surgery boundary.
A = Z/2 may specialize to the n31 omega/theta target only as a provisional falsification target until source slots are filled.

specialization_checks.description: For the trivial finite group A, the candidate contract expects the only sector to specialize to the ordinary omega candidate, while still carrying ordinary-surgery gate metadata.
For A = Z/2, the nontrivial character sector is expected to align with the theta target only after n31 source capture and convention reconciliation confirm that target.
Finite-A character data must pass exact row and column orthogonality checks with no floating-point approximations.
Zero / all-trivial decorations must be represented explicitly and must route to the ordinary candidate sector, not to an unstated decorated formula.
